package nats

import (
	"bytes"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func validLearningActionClosedPayload() []byte {
	return []byte(`{
  "event_id": "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
  "event_type": "learning_action.closed",
  "correlation_id": "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
  "causation_id": "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
  "student_id": "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
  "occurred_at": "2026-08-30T10:00:00Z",
  "schema_version": 1,
  "data": {
    "learning_action_id": "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
    "context_type": "lesson_task",
    "context_id": "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
    "learning_targets": [
      {"type": "capability", "key": "learning.semantic-sequence", "version": "v1"}
    ]
  }
}`)
}

func TestDecodeLearningActionClosed(t *testing.T) {
	closure, err := DecodeLearningActionClosed(validLearningActionClosedPayload())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, closure.LearningActionID, closure.CorrelationID)
	require.Equal(t, "learning.semantic-sequence", closure.LearningTargets[0].Key)
}

func TestDecodeLearningActionClosedRejectsUnsupportedVersion(t *testing.T) {
	payload := bytes.Replace(validLearningActionClosedPayload(), []byte(`"schema_version": 1`), []byte(`"schema_version": 2`), 1)
	_, err := DecodeLearningActionClosed(payload)
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "unsupported")
}

func TestDecodeLearningActionClosedRejectsObjectiveFacts(t *testing.T) {
	payload := bytes.Replace(validLearningActionClosedPayload(), []byte(`"context_type": "lesson_task"`), []byte(`"passed": true, "context_type": "lesson_task"`), 1)
	_, err := DecodeLearningActionClosed(payload)
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "unknown field")
}

func TestDecodeLearningActionClosedRejectsDuplicateTarget(t *testing.T) {
	payload := bytes.Replace(
		validLearningActionClosedPayload(),
		[]byte(`{"type": "capability", "key": "learning.semantic-sequence", "version": "v1"}`),
		[]byte(`{"type": "capability", "key": "learning.semantic-sequence", "version": "v1"}, {"type": "capability", "key": "learning.semantic-sequence", "version": "v1"}`),
		1,
	)
	_, err := DecodeLearningActionClosed(payload)
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "duplicate")
}
